identity.title: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sun & Moon Arc

source.sourceCategory: Category:Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sun & Moon Arc

leadText:
----
(Japanese: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sun & Moon Arc) is a by Ryū Matsushima based on the Pokémon Trading Card Game. It was serialized in the CoroCoro Ichiban! magazine from the January 2017 issue (released on November 21, 2016) to the January 2020 issue (released on November 21, 2019). It is the sequel of Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY! and is followed by Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sword & Shield Arc. It tells the story of the brothers Shin and Makoto Kyougi.

The manga was collected into four volumes that are simply referred to as (Japanese: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!). Instead of being labeled numerically, they are individually titled (Japanese: SolgaleoGX LunalaGX Clash! Arc), (Japanese: Ultra Beast Invasion! Arc), (Japanese: GX Start Deck Arc), and (Japanese: Tag Team GX Arc). Each volume is 192 pages long.
